ED_Title: 2028 United Nations Conference to Support the Implementation of Sustainable Development Goal 14: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development
ED_DecisionText: At its 109th plenary meeting, on 31 August 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of Chile, Republic of Korea and Viet Nam (footnote: A/80/L.109.) [sponsors to be updated based on the proceedings], recalled its resolution 80/108 of 9 December 2025, in which it had decided to consider, before the end of the eightieth session of the General Assembly, the modalities of the 2028 United Nations Conference to Support the Implementation of Sustainable Development Goal 14: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development in the most efficient and effective manner possible, and decided to extend its consideration until 31 December 2026.
